test_title: PYST 47: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 17 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: A, B, C, E, F, P, and Q are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre. A sits fourth to the left of C. P sits fourth to the right of B. Only two people sit between C and B, when counted from the left of C. E is not an immediate neighbour of P or B. F is not an immediate neighbour of P. Who sits third to the right of Q?
solution:
Given: A, B, C, E, F, P and Q sit around a circular table facing the centre.

A sits fourth to the left of C.

P sits fourth to the right of B.

Only two people sit between C and B when counted from the left of C.

E is not an immediate neighbour of P or B.

F is not an immediate neighbour of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3a8240134c8eefd3e9bf57b01e4c6c703e5d18f59e6ce5a304946eb37485e26.png] 

So, F sits third to the right of Q.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
